question: For each subnet (by subnet name), show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of IP allocation pools per subnet, considering only subnets that have at least one DNS nameserver entry and excluding shared networks (i.e., networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'). Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH subnet_pool_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    s.name AS subnet_name,
    COUNT(p.id) AS pool_count
  FROM subnets s
  INNER JOIN ipallocationpools p ON s.id = p.subnet_id
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM dnsnameservers d WHERE d.subnet_id = s.id
  )
  AND s.network_id NOT IN (
    SELECT nr.object_id 
    FROM networkrbacs nr 
    WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared' 
    AND nr.target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
  )
  GROUP BY s.name
)
SELECT 
  subnet_name,
  MAX(pool_count) - MIN(pool_count) AS range_val,
  VARIANCE(pool_count) AS variance,
  STDDEV(pool_count) AS stddev
FROM subnet_pool_counts
GROUP BY subnet_name
